events.title: Demo 0.42 (Steam Next Fest Update)
events.summary: The first update for the Catacrypt Demo is out! This update includes some small content additions, a minor rework to the first boss fight, and controller support. The additions from this update are designed to make the game an overall better experience, so I hope everyone enjoys it!New:Added 1 new bow.Added 2 new throwing weapons.Added 1 new room.Added 1 new enemy.Added a new wave to the Necrotic Totem boss fight.Added controller support.Added support for Steam Cloud.Added 2 new equipment slots,

events.title: Demo Released
events.summary: The Catacrypt Demo has just been released! This is a continuation of the Open Playtest, where this version will receive content updates to push it towards the final version of the game. Many of the major bugs and issues were fixed in the Playtest, and many more have been fixed since the last version of the Playtest.
